services.name: Nature Walking Tour
services.desc: Explore the beautiful ecosystem of the park! Cost Individual (12 and over): $5 per person Children ages 12 and under: Free Duration 90 minutes Location Meet at The Water Works (105 Sabine St.) Time 9 - 10:30am About Learn about native plants and the insects that pollinate them along Buffalo Bayou. Follow along this discovery tour of Houston’s historic waterway ecosystem with Nancy Greig, founding director of the Cockrell Butterfly Center (now retired). An avid natural historian “jack of all trades”, she has particular interest in plants and insects, but birds, mammals, herpetofauna, and fish are all on her radar. services.desc: Step into a resonant landscape of voices and light with Undercurrents, a new interactive art installation by Rafael Lozano-Hemmer. This immersive experience transforms the Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern into an echoing chamber of sound, illumination, and memory, revealing how communication travels across time, space, and human relationships. services.name: Buffalo Bayou Boat Cruise (45-minute tours)
services.desc: Escape within the heart of the city and glide along Buffalo Bayou. From the waterway, look for wildlife and unique views of Houston's skyline. Rates Person (Ages 12+): $15 Child (Ages 4 - 12): $12 Duration 45 minutes About These 45-minute boat rides are a great way to spend the time on the water with your family and friends. Escape the bustle of the city and enjoy the cool breeze as you glide along Buffalo Bayou’s waters. Look for graceful herons, jumping fish, and even an occasional alligator on the banks. services.name: Sound Healing Meditation in the Cistern
services.desc: Rates Person (ages 9+): $20.00 Duration 45 Minutes About Step into a deeper stillness inside the spacious and tranquil Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern. Offered in collaboration with UNIONisCREATION™, this meditation and sound experience invites guests into a space of resonance, restoration, and inner alignment. Through gentle vibrations of singing bowls, wind chimes, and a gong, along with guided awareness, participants are supported in reconnecting body and mind. This series is more than meditation - it is a practice of listening, feeling, and returning to center within one of Houston's most iconic, immersive spaces. services.name: Birding Boat Tour
services.desc: Climb aboard our pontoon boat tour for a unique and immersive experience observing birds in their natural habitat along Buffalo Bayou. Birding guides will take you on an informative, relaxing, and scenic journey that allows you to spot a variety of birds from a unique vantage point. We encourage you to bring your own binoculars. services.name: Buffalo Bayou Cruise: History
services.desc: Take a boat ride through history and learn about Houston's past! Rates Adult : $40 Child (Ages 4-12): $32 Senior (65+)/Military/Student/Youth (13-19): $32 Duration 90 minutes About Look back at Houston’s history while cruising Buffalo Bayou with a local historian. Your guide will share stories of the Allen brothers and provide historical information about the people, places and events along the bayou that helped shape Houston. Reservations required. Schedule 2:30pm - 4pm Boat tours depart promptly at departure time. Location 1019 Commerce Street (at Main Street), go down the cascading stairs (on your left of the 3-story brown brick building). The pontoon boat will be docked at the wharf.

services.name: Spirits of the Bayou Boat Tour
services.desc: Enjoy spooky season with ghost stories and more with views of Haunted Houston! Rates Person: $40 Senior (65+)/Military/Student (with valid ID/Youth (13-17) $32 Duration 90 minutes About Join this ghostly history cruise and get in the Halloween spirit. Tour guide Andrew Groocock will share some of the haunted tales and legends of Buffalo Bayou. Hear some of the lesser-known stories – both documented and anecdotal – of ghosts, lost souls, and spirits of the bayou. Departure location: Allen’s Landing, 1019 Commerce St., Houston, TX 77002 Weather permitting. Reservations Required. What to Bring Dress in weather-appropriate clothing with the understanding that it will be about 5 degrees cooler

services.name: Barbara Fish Daniel Picnic Pavilion For Children
services.desc: Great for children's birthday parties! Rates Three Hour Rental: $150 About Near The Water Works and the Lee and Joe Jamail Skatepark, the Barbara Fish Daniel Nature Play Area and Picnic Pavilion is one of the park’s most popular destinations for children and families. Designed to inspire a love of nature within children, features of the play area include: a boulder rock scramble, a rolling lawn, a stream and waterfall, climbing logs and stones, and a 33-foot slide. The most compelling component is a tri-level treehouse/boat deck with climbing net. You can rent the picnic pavilion for children’s parties and family events for children (6 picnic tables accommodate 40 guests). ADULTS IN PLAY
